## Biography

Sheikh Mohammad Rakib is a full stack developer who specialises in creating
thoughtful digital experiences. With 3+ years of professional experience and
20+ shipped projects, he sits at the intersection of engineering precision
and design sensibility.

He cares deeply about code quality, design accuracy, motion design, and the
stories that products tell. His work spans product companies, agency work,
and open source contributions.

## Technical Skills

### Frontend
- React 18+ (hooks, context, server/client components)
- Next.js 15 (App Router, RSC, streaming, metadata API)
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS, CSS Modules
- Responsive design, fluid typography, CSS Grid/Flexbox

### Animation & Motion
- GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) — core, ScrollTrigger, useGSAP
- Motion / Framer Motion (motion/react) — whileInView, variants, MotionValues
- CSS transitions and keyframe animations
- SplitText word-masking reveal patterns
- Scroll-driven parallax and scrub animations

### Backend & Infrastructure
- Node.js, REST API design
- Server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG)
- Vercel deployment and edge functions

### Design Tools
- Figma (component libraries, design tokens, auto layout)
- Design systems and component-driven development
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)
- Motion design principles and micro-interactions
